prompt_prefix: Return exactly one read-only SQLite SELECT query (WITH is allowed). Return SQL only, without
Markdown. Use the exact target table names.

questionResults.question: How many pantries are in each city?
questionResults.sql: SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS pantry_count FROM pantry p JOIN adress a ON a.address_id = p.address_id GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY a.city;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: city: Denver, pantry_count: 1; city: Phoenix, pantry_count: 1; city: Provo, pantry_count: 1

questionResults.question: What is the total quantity of food in each pantry, including shelves and cupboards?
questionResults.sql: WITH inventory AS (SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity, best_by_date FROM shelfs UNION ALL SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity, best_by_date FROM cupboards) SELECT p.pantry_id, a.city, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM pantry p JOIN adress a ON a.address_id = p.address_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.pantry_id = p.pantry_id GROUP BY p.pantry_id, a.city ORDER BY p.pantry_id;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: pantry_id: 1, city: Provo, total_quantity: 21; pantry_id: 2, city: Denver, total_quantity: 11; pantry_id: 3, city: Phoenix, total_quantity: 10

questionResults.question: Which foods have a quantity of zero, and in which pantry?
questionResults.sql: WITH inventory AS (SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity, best_by_date FROM shelfs UNION ALL SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity, best_by_date FROM cupboards) SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity = 0 ORDER BY pantry_id, food_name;

questionResults.question: Which pantry has the most food?
questionResults.sql: WITH inventory AS (SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity, best_by_date FROM shelfs UNION ALL SELECT pantry_id, food_name, quantity, best_by_date FROM cupboards) SELECT p.pantry_id, a.city, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM pantry p JOIN adress a ON a.address_id = p.address_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.pantry_id = p.pantry_id GROUP BY p.pantry_id, a.city ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.pantry_id LIMIT 1;
